techniques.name: staggered_link_cloud_cascade
techniques.when: Displaying dense directories, tag clouds, or ecosystem navigation links (e.g., Creators, Advertise, Developers, Safety).
techniques.how: Cluster related links into compact chip or text layers across multiple columns/rows. Trigger the first row at 0.0s with slide_up, followed by subsequent rows staggered at intervals of 0.15s with fade or pop to create a cascading wave of interactive anchors.

techniques.name: minimalist_legal_footer_lockup
techniques.when: Signing off an informational video with compliance terms, privacy policy links, and corporate copyright marks.
techniques.how: Establish a structural boundary with a horizontal line wiping across the lower screen quadrant at 0.0s. Stagger legal policy links above the line with rise at 0.3s, then reveal the copyright line below at 0.5s with a soft fade.

techniques.name: spotlight_partner_badge_reveal
techniques.when: Highlighting a premium featured partnership or product offering amidst standard informational text (e.g., NFL Sunday Ticket).
techniques.how: Mute baseline metadata text with low-opacity fade entrances, then punch out the hero partnership badge using a pop or zoom entrance on an accent card or rrect layer to draw immediate viewer focus.
